description: Explains New York's LLC publication requirement (LLC Law §206 for New York LLCs, §802 for out-of-state LLCs registered in New York): who must publish, how (two newspapers designated by the county clerk, one daily and one weekly, once a week for six weeks), the 120-day deadline and when it starts, what happens if it is missed (authority suspended, no fine, curable by publishing late), and whether it repeats (it does not). Use for 'do I have to publish', 'what happens if I don't', 'I missed the deadline' and similar. Do NOT use for prices (get_publication_price) or a specific LLC (lookup_new_york_llc).

situation.description: What the user is asking about. Default general.
